scene.speaker: nico
scene.bubble: Beach day! Sun, sand, a giant castle… and Pip swimming like a champion!
scene.intro: Beach day! Nico builds a giant castle with wet sand and puts one shell on every tower. The sun is hot, so he wears his blue hat and eats a very fast ice cream before it melts. And Pip? Pip swims like a champion, up and down, up and down — he is a sea bird after all. Do you like the beach? What do you do there? Take your hat and come to the sand!

data.text:
It is a hot day and Nico is at the beach with Freya.
Nico is making a big castle with the sand. Freya is swimming in the sea.
Pip is sleeping under a red hat. He is very happy.
Then Freya sees a small fish. 'Come here, Nico!' she says. 'Look at this fish!'

questions.q: What does Freya see in the sea?

homework.prompt: Draw a beach day and write 4 sentences about what you do there.
